The whole order happens inside one WhatsApp chat — no sign-up forms, no waiting days.

3

Good to know

Common questions

Netflix is asking for a login or household code — what do I do?

Don't worry — this is normal on Netflix profiles. Just message us on WhatsApp and we will guide you or send the code.

Quick self-fix that works for many customers: on the sign-in screen choose Get Help → sign in with password instead of the email code option, using the details we sent you.

What are the CapCut Pro device rules?

CapCut Pro from Digicounts is a 1 device login only account — phone, tablet or laptop, but only one device.

Please take this seriously: if you try to log in on more than one device, CapCut detects the login attempts and the account can be locked, restricted or stopped (too many login attempts, account locked, access denied). In that case Digicounts will not be responsible and cannot fix or replace the account — by buying, you agree to use it on one device only.

So pick your main device first, and message us on WhatsApp before ever switching devices.

How is my subscription delivered?

Everything is delivered on WhatsApp, in the same chat where you ordered. After we verify your payment screenshot, we send your login details and stay in the chat until you are set up.

How do I pay?

We accept FonePay. When you order, we send the payment QR inside our WhatsApp chat — we never ask you to pay any other number or account.

In the payment remarks, write only your full name, then send us the screenshot so we can match and deliver your order.

When can I reach support?

We are online every day, 2 PM – 10 PM (Nepal time). Login problem, code not coming, plan question — message us on WhatsApp in those hours and we will sort it out.

Ready to watch?

Message us on WhatsApp, pay by FonePay, and start watching in 4K — usually within minutes.
